sources.text:
Cedar Library visitor guide.
Cedar Library closes at 5 PM Monday through Friday.
Cedar Library closes at 7 PM on Saturday and Sunday.
Visitors must bring their library card.
The quiet room is on the second floor.

Cedar Garden planting guide.
Plant basil in well-drained soil. Water the soil when the top layer is dry. Place pots near a sunny window.
This document does not describe any library or its opening hours.
